description: Manually authored synthetic corpus and reviewed starter labels. This is an evaluator fixture, not a production-quality score.

pages.text: Submit paid time off requests at least five business days before the first day off. Managers respond within two business days.
Employees may roll over up to five unused paid time off days. Rolled days expire on March 31 of the following year.
Full-time employees receive a $50 monthly wellness stipend. Submit receipts to payroll by the fifth calendar day of the next month.
Eligible employees receive twelve weeks of parental leave. Notify Human Resources at least thirty calendar days before the planned leave when possible.
Book domestic travel at least fourteen calendar days before departure. Standard bookings must use economy class.
The standard hotel limit is $220 per night before taxes. A higher rate requires written approval from the department director before booking.
Employees traveling overnight may claim a meal allowance of up to $65 per travel day. Alcohol is not reimbursable.
Submit an itemized expense report within ten business days after returning. Attach receipts for individual expenses over $25.
Multi-factor authentication is required for every VPN login. Use the company authenticator app or an approved hardware security key.
Report a lost company device to IT within one hour. IT will revoke its access and initiate a remote lock or wipe.
Passwords must be at least fourteen characters. Do not reuse any of your previous ten passwords.
Report suspected phishing to the Security team within thirty minutes using the Report Phishing button. Do not click links or open attachments.
